answer: One concrete sybil defense is tiered admission cost: the Nth identity an operator registers must burn more proof than the last, so cost grows faster than the number of fakes. A farmer teeters on a ledge where each new puppet costs more than the one before, turning a linear plan into an exponential bill. Honest agents, needing only one identity, pay a small fixed toll. A sybil swarm must spend ivory-thick capital yet finds each marginal vote worth less than its cost, while a single real yarrow stands cheap.
